title: Policy model: region pinning storage + validation + admin APIs
creator: Ethan Park
body:
Context / goal
We need a canonical, validated policy model for data residency region pinning that can be configured by admins (Console + API) and consumed reliably by the gateway/router. This ticket delivers:
1) persistent storage schema for residency policy
2) validation + precedence rules per ADR-042
3) admin APIs to read/update policy at org/project/workspace scope

This is a prerequisite for request-path enforcement (ENG-2842) and routing constraints (ENG-2843).

Requirements (from PRD + ADR pointers)
- Support two related concepts:
  - pinned_region: a single region where requests must be processed (no cross-region fallback unless explicitly overridden elsewhere)
  - allowed_regions: an explicit allow-list for processing (may be a single region; may be multiple for special cases)
- Scope/precedence:
  - Evaluate effective policy with precedence: workspace > project > org > platform default
  - Explicit null should clear an inherited setting (e.g., workspace unpins and inherits project policy) — see validation section for the chosen representation.
- Supported products:
  - Hosted + Dedicated: configurable
  - Private/VPC: policy is informational in control plane (enforcement happens in customer environment); still store for evidence + Console display but do not block config if region codes don’t map 1:1 to Hosted regions.

Proposed storage model
Table: residency_policies (new)
- policy_id (uuid)
- scope_type: org | project | workspace
- scope_id (uuid)
- pinned_region (string, nullable)
- allowed_regions (string[], nullable)  // stored as an array in DB; serialized to JSON in API
- allow_cross_region_fallback (bool, nullable) // default false when pinned; set only via exception workflow/feature flag (enforcement tickets will gate)
- created_by / updated_by (user id)
- created_at / updated_at
- version (int) for optimistic concurrency on update

Notes:
- We will not store “effective policy” on write; evaluation happens in policy evaluator service with caching.
- For existing org config (legacy org.default_region / deployment_region), add a one-time migration to populate pinned_region at org scope.

Validation rules
On write (admin API):
- Region codes must be in the platform-supported set for Hosted/Dedicated (e.g., us-east, us-west, eu-west, eu-central) except for Private where we accept any opaque string but warn.
- allowed_regions:
  - if provided: must be non-empty; must not contain duplicates; must only contain valid region identifiers.
- pinned_region:
  - if provided: must be a valid region identifier.
  - if allowed_regions is provided, pinned_region must be an element of allowed_regions.
- Coherency:
  - If pinned_region is set and allowed_regions is null, we will materialize allowed_regions=[pinned_region] at write time (simplifies downstream evaluation).
  - If pinned_region is null and allowed_regions has length==1, do NOT auto-pin (keep semantics explicit; pinning affects routing/fallback behavior).
- Clearing/inheritance:
  - Use explicit PATCH semantics:
    - omit field => no change
    - set pinned_region="" (empty string) or allowed_regions=[] is rejected
    - set pinned_region=null => clear pin at that scope
    - set allowed_regions=null => clear allow-list at that scope

API surface (internal + admin)
1) Internal service-to-service (policy evaluator will call DB, but other services may need read-only):
- GET /internal/policies/residency?scope_type=...&scope_id=...
- GET /internal/policies/residency/effective?workspace_id=... (optional convenience endpoint; can be added later if needed)

2) Admin APIs (Console + Terraform later)
- GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/residency-policy
- PATCH /v1/orgs/{org_id}/residency-policy
- GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/residency-policy
- PATCH /v1/projects/{project_id}/residency-policy
- GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/residency-policy
- PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/residency-policy

Authz/RBAC
- New permission: residency.policy:read and residency.policy:write (RBAC bundle PR tracked separately).
- Console will require write permission for editing; read permission for viewing the effective policy banner.

Responses / error format
- Use standard API error envelope.
- Validation failures should return 400 with field-level details:
  - error_code=INVALID_RESIDENCY_POLICY
  - include fields: invalid_fields=["pinned_region"], message with remediation

Out of scope (handled in follow-ups)
- Enforcement behavior at gateway/router (ENG-2842/2843)
- Audit event emission for allow/deny (ENG-2844)
- Exception workflow + time-bounded overrides (separate security/GRC process)

Acceptance criteria
- [x] DB schema and migrations landed (including backfill from legacy org region config)
- [x] Admin APIs implemented for org/project/workspace scopes with PATCH semantics
- [x] Validation rules implemented + unit tested (pinned_region ∈ allowed_regions, supported region set, null clearing)
- [x] Basic integration tests: create/update/clear at org + project; verify readback and version increments
- [x] Documentation in service README: endpoints, payload examples, and validation behavior
- [ ] Security review sign-off on validation and RBAC gating (Marcus Lin / Olga Petrov as needed)

Implementation notes
- Owner: Benji Okafor
- Migration: Michael Nguyen to review/approve the legacy config mapping (ensure we don’t pin customers unexpectedly if their legacy field is unset)
- Policy model consultation: Jordan Lee (ADR-042 alignment, inheritance semantics)

Payload examples
PATCH org residency policy (pin EU):
{"pinned_region":"eu-west","allowed_regions":["eu-west"]}

Allow list without pin (rare; for orgs that want multi-region processing but no strict pin):
{"pinned_region":null,"allowed_regions":["eu-west","eu-central"]}

Clear policy at project scope to inherit org:
{"pinned_region":null,"allowed_regions":null}

Progress updates
2025-01-17 (Benji): Drafted schema + validation matrix; open question on whether to auto-materialize allowed_regions when pinned_region set.
2025-01-21 (Jordan): Prefer materializing allowed_regions=[pinned_region] on write; keeps evaluation deterministic and reduces downstream edge cases.
2025-01-28 (Michael): Migration approach OK; ensure we only backfill when legacy field is explicitly set (avoid creating pinned policies for orgs without configured region).
2025-02-03 (Benji): APIs + migrations implemented; added tests for duplicate regions and pinned not in allowed. Ready for review.

Review checklist for approvers
- Confirm PATCH null-clearing semantics match Console expectations
- Confirm region identifier set matches current Hosted/Dedicated region naming
- Confirm error envelope + codes align with API standards (Brian Murphy)

Links
- Initiative: PM-482
- Related: ENG-2842 (gateway enforcement), ENG-2843 (routing), ENG-2846 (console hookup)
- ADR reference: ADR-042 (region pinning policy model)
